rationaleNote: Lesson teaches children to say the value of a coin in a full sentence; My Turn slide models the completion, so the stems are paired (gappy + modelled) on one card.

items.text: The value of the coin is ___.
items.filled: The value of the coin is 10 pence.

items.text: I know this coin is worth ___ because ___.
items.filled: I know this coin is worth 5 pence because it has 5p written on it.
